systems.system: Kenya Patient Summary (KPS) FHIR Implementation Guide
systems.platform: HL7 FHIR 4.0.1, adapted from the International Patient Summary
systems.owner: Digital Health Agency; built by IntelliSOFT Consulting
systems.tiers: intended for community clinics, county hospitals, referral centres and emergency settings

note: A draft interoperability specification (version 0.1.0, continuous build, 'not an authorized publication') for sharing a patient summary between EMRs. It is class exchange and states nothing about any EMR or HMIS in use, so no fact.
